title: Calmer, clearer combat
changes: The screen no longer shakes every time you get hit, swing a finisher or cast a skill. Only huge blows like boss slams give a small nudge.
No more white screen flash on high-level weapon finishers.
Getting hit no longer cuts your own swing short, so your attacks always play out.

A red ring now marks the monster you're attacking (a gold ring shows the one under your mouse). Clicking right next to a small monster counts as clicking it, and if you keep holding the button after a kill, you move on to the next monster under your mouse.
